data.title: Junior Frontend Developer
data.fitReason: Directly aligns with candidate's HTML/CSS/JavaScript skills and 2 completed personal projects demonstrating practical frontend implementation. Entry-level role explicitly designed for fresh graduates with foundational web development knowledge.

data.title: QA Automation Tester (Junior)
data.fitReason: Builds directly on 6-month manual testing internship experience. JavaScript skills enable transition to test automation scripting. Natural career progression from manual QA background with lower barrier to entry than pure development roles.

data.title: Manual QA Tester
data.fitReason: Perfect match for immediate employment with proven 6-month internship experience in manual testing. Can contribute immediately without additional training in core testing methodologies, defect identification, and test case execution.

data.title: Web Developer (Entry-Level)
data.fitReason: Possesses core web development fundamentals (HTML/CSS/JavaScript) and demonstrated ability to build functional projects. Entry-level positioning accommodates lack of professional employment history while leveraging existing technical foundation.

data.title: Junior UI Developer
data.fitReason: Strong match for HTML/CSS expertise demonstrated through personal projects. UI-focused role emphasizes frontend presentation layer skills without requiring backend complexity. Aligns with current skill set and learning trajectory.

data.title: Test Engineer (Junior)
data.fitReason: Bridges QA internship experience with technical development skills. JavaScript knowledge enables progression toward test automation and technical QA responsibilities beyond manual testing scope.

data.title: Junior Web Content Developer
data.fitReason: Leverages HTML/CSS expertise for content management and static web page development. Lower technical barrier than full development roles while utilizing existing frontend skills effectively.

data.title: QA Support Specialist
data.fitReason: Entry-level QA role combining manual testing experience with technical interest. Provides stable entry point into quality assurance career path with mentorship opportunity to develop deeper technical skills.

data.title: Junior Frontend QA Engineer
data.fitReason: Hybrid role combining both skill areas: frontend development knowledge (HTML/CSS/JavaScript) with QA testing experience. Positions candidate to test frontend functionality with technical development understanding.

data.title: Web Development Intern (Paid)
data.fitReason: Extended internship role appropriate for fresh graduate seeking additional mentorship and real-world experience. Allows skill consolidation and deeper technical exposure before permanent junior developer placement.
